user: can you adjust what transcribe understands, e.g. some room names are pretty hard to pronounce or are unlikely to be understood wihtout the transcription model knowing that its valid, so is there basically a straight forward path to increase the words the transcription model understands

assistant: **Yes—there’s a straightforward path: supply the transcription model with a vocabulary of names from the current building.** No model training is needed.

assistant: Google supports this in both options:

assistant: - **Gemini Live transcription:** accepts a `custom_vocabulary` list containing room names, unusual words, and technical terms. [Google’s documentation](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/live-api/live-transcribe#custom-vocabulary-biasing)
assistant: - **Cloud Speech-to-Text:** supports phrase hints and custom classes, plus adjustable “boost” values to make particular terms more likely. Availability depends on the model and language. [Google’s adaptation guide](https://docs.cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/adaptation-model)

assistant: For Blueprint, I’d propose this flow:

assistant: 1. Extract room names from the IFC properties or labels read from the drawing.
assistant: 2. Include those names when starting the transcription session.
assistant: 3. Allow user-defined aliases—for example, “plant room” referring to the room labelled “Talotekniikka.”
assistant: 4. Keep the transcript editable when a name is still misunderstood.

assistant: Vocabulary hints help the recognizer choose an unusual name when the audio sounds like it. **Aliases are a separate application feature:** they let someone use an easier name and still refer to the correct room.

assistant: This improves recognition without guaranteeing it; excessive bias can also produce a room name that wasn’t spoken. We should compare the same recordings with and without hints, including questions that don’t mention any listed room. [Google’s boost guidance](https://docs.cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/adaptation-model#boost_basics)

assistant: I’d include **vocabulary specific to the uploaded building** in this branch’s deliverable. The documented Gemini Live support also means this requirement doesn’t force us to use Cloud Speech-to-Text.
